title: Grok Bot Links to Calendar and Contacts on iOS and Android

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Mobile users are gaining the ability to let their digital assistants manage personal schedules and address books through a new integration. Grok Bot is currently rolling out functionality to interact with Calendar, Reminders, and Contacts apps on both iOS and Android devices, allowing the assistant to utilize on-device data to perform tasks.

The update provides Apple users with additional connectivity to Alarms, Location, and Home apps. These capabilities are being deployed across both major mobile operating systems to extend the bot's reach into native system applications.
